question.text: Scenario: Harish is an active mutual fund investor with folios across multiple schemes of ABC Mutual Fund. On a particular Wednesday (a working day with no holidays that week), the following events occur: Transaction 1: At 1:30 PM, Harish submits a purchase application for Rs.3,00,000 in ABC Equity Growth Fund with an RTGS payment that is credited to the scheme's account by 2:00 PM. The scheme's current NAV is Rs.125. Transaction 2: At 3:30 PM (after the 1:30 PM liquid-fund purchase cutoff), he submits another purchase application for Rs.2,00,000 in ABC Liquid Fund through online mode with instant payment. Transaction 3: On the same day at 2:00 PM, his monthly SIP of Rs.10,000 in ABC Balanced Advantage Fund is auto-triggered by the RTA. The mandate debit is successful. Transaction 4: He submits a switch request at 2:30 PM to move Rs.1,00,000 from ABC Overnight Fund to ABC Mid Cap Fund. Transaction 5: His standing STP instruction triggers a transfer of Rs.25,000 from ABC Liquid Fund to ABC Small Cap Fund. Question 2 of 5: At which NAV will Transaction 2 (liquid fund purchase at 3:30 PM after cutoff) be processed?

answer.text: Thursday's NAV, since the application was submitted after the cutoff time
Wednesday's NAV, being the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the next business day
Thursday's NAV, since payment was made instantly
Friday's NAV, since liquid fund purchases have a T+2 NAV rule

explanation.text: The Logic: For liquid fund purchases/switch-ins the cutoff is 1:30 PM. Where the application is received after the cutoff with funds available the same day, the applicable NAV is the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the next business day. Wednesday is followed by Thursday (a business day), so the day immediately preceding Thursday is Wednesday — hence Wednesday's NAV applies to Harish's 3:30 PM application. The Trap: The intuitive answer is Thursday's NAV (because the application was after cutoff), but the liquid-fund rule specifically points to the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the next business day. Note: Funds must be available with the AMC for the same-day-credit clause to apply; otherwise the cutoff-plus-realisation rules push NAV further.
